answer_1.quote: For each modality M j , we leverage a dataset of Captioning (Cap) task and a dataset of Question Answering (QA) task... For image modality, we use MSCOCO-2014 and OK-VQA... For video modality, we use MSVD and MSVD-QA... For audio modality, we use AudioCaps and Clotho-AQA... For point cloud modality, we use a subset of Cap3D and a subset of Cap3D-QA.
answer_1.outputs: captions for captioning tasks and answers for question answering tasks

answer_2.quote: we utilize CIDEr score and prediction accuracy (Acc) for Cap and QA tasks respectively to calculate S sup j,k and S i j,k.

answer_3.quote: For the calculation of prediction accuracy, we leverage a GPT-based open-ended QA evaluation with GPT-4o mini as the judge model. The GPT is prompted to judge whether the generated prediction semantically matches the ground truth answer.
